name: Grandstream GXP/GRP Series
description: Grandstream P-value XML configuration served as cfg<mac>.xml.

sip.username.description: SIP user / auth id. Resolved from the extension when left empty.

sip.password.description: SIP secret. Resolved from the extension when left empty.

sip.domain.description: SIP registrar / domain the phone registers to.

user.display_name.description: Caller ID name shown on the device.

device.mac.description: Device MAC address, used for the configuration filename.

outputs.template:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!-- Generated by Oryk Provisioner for {{device.name}} ({{device.mac_colon}}) -->
<gs_provision version="1">
  <mac>{{device.mac}}</mac>
  <config version="1">
    <P271>1</P271>
    <P270>{{user.display_name}}</P270>
    <P47>{{sip.domain}}:{{sip.port}}</P47>
    <P35>{{sip.username}}</P35>
    <P36>{{sip.auth_username}}</P36>
    <P34>{{sip.password}}</P34>
    <P3>{{user.display_name}}</P3>
    <P40>{{sip.voicemail_number|default:*97}}</P40>
    <P32>{{sip.register_expires|default:300}}</P32>
    <P130>{{#if sip.secure}}2{{else}}0{{/if}}</P130>
    <P237>{{provisioning.root_url}}</P237>
    <P30>{{system.ntp_server|default:pool.ntp.org}}</P30>
  </config>
</gs_provision>
